sources.title: Decisions
sources.detail: A question an agent asked you, with options and a recommendation. Leaves when you answer it or it is withdrawn.

sources.title: Questions
sources.detail: An agent question assigned to you. Leaves when answered, dismissed or withdrawn. Answer from Inbox or its conversation.

sources.title: Agent work to check
sources.detail: A card an agent moved to Review or Blocked, for the person who handed it off. Leaves when the card moves on.

sources.title: Follow-ups to send
sources.detail: After a call with people outside the team, a drafted follow-up and the tasks it proposed. Leaves when you approve or dismiss it, or after a week.

sources.title: Unread talk
sources.detail: A subject conversation with something unread. Leaves when read.

sources.title: Guest messages
sources.detail: A guest or an organization wrote on a subject you can see, and nobody here has answered. Leaves when someone replies or you dismiss it.

sources.title: Starlings support
sources.detail: Starlings support answered a question you asked in Help. Leaves when you read it.

sources.title: Proposed tasks
sources.detail: A proposed task. Leaves when accepted or declined.

sources.title: Quick Notes
sources.detail: A note not yet filed. Leaves when filed or deleted.

sources.title: Sales touches
sources.detail: A CRM touch with no lead yet, with Sales on. Leaves when a lead starts or it is dismissed.

sources.title: Document comments
sources.detail: An open comment thread on a document about your subjects. Leaves when resolved.

sources.title: Bookings
sources.detail: A guest booked, moved or cancelled a time on your page. Leaves when filed, dismissed, or the meeting starts.

sources.title: Calendar invitations
sources.detail: Someone invited you to an event. Leaves when you accept, decline or say maybe, or when the event ends.

sources.title: Events from email
sources.detail: An event read from mail you forwarded to calendar@. Leaves when you add or discard it, or after a week.

sources.title: Interest
sources.detail: A company filled in /interest, for admins. Leaves when dismissed.

sources.title: Form submissions
sources.detail: Someone filled in one of the workspace’s public forms, for the people the form names. Leaves when dismissed.

sources.title: Offers and licenses
sources.detail: An offer that expires within a week, or a license that renews within 30 days, on a lead or organization you can see, with Sales on. Leaves when it is decided or renewed, or when dismissed.
